chunks: From him, from Abū Jaʿfar, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man moved down toward sajdah and does not know whether he performed rukuʿ or did not perform rukuʿ. He said: He has performed rukuʿ.

key_terms.قَدْ رَكَعَ: he has already performed the bowing
key_terms.لَا يَدْرِي: he does not know; he is in doubt
key_terms.يَرْكَعْ: to perform rukuʿ; here, whether he did not bow

ai.seo_question: If someone doubts during salat after moving toward sajdah whether they performed rukuʿ, what is the ruling?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding doubt in salat (prayer). If a person has already gone down toward sajdah and then doubts whether he performed rukuʿ, the ruling stated is that he is to treat the rukuʿ as having been performed.
